svg.title: The communication and pivot evidence
svg.desc: Magnify board and pivot evidence as two related findings. Storage communication and network reach need distinct shapes so neither becomes a vague generic breach icon. Visual distinction: A solid tiled network wall with disconnected cable ends. Indicates unavailable reach, not a decision awaiting human approval.
